summary.text: Nathan Schmig is the Democratic candidate for the Minnesota House of Representatives, District 15A, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces Republican Brad Hennen.
A truck driver who collects garbage for Olson Sanitation, he lists health care, education, justice and environmental action as his policy interests.

paragraphs.text: Nathan Schmig earned a high school diploma from Canby High School and works as a truck driver.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he grew up on a farm, graduated from Canby, has lived in Minneota for about 30 years, is married and has four children.
He said he has driven a garbage truck for Olson Sanitation for about fifteen years, after earlier jobs in a grocery store bakery, a hotel and several factories.
Schmig said he has never lobbied a legislator at the Capitol or led an organization larger than the Friends of the Minneota Public Library.
Among his listed campaign messages, he said health care should be available and affordable and called for justice for Minnesotans he said had been affected by federal immigration agents.
